BlockedUnlockPickup.u0: Initially, the agent must pick up the ball in order to move on. If the ball is not acquired, no progress is made and the agent remains focused on obtaining the ball.
BlockedUnlockPickup.u1: At this point, the primary requirement is to have the key. If the agent does not possess the key, it remains in this phase until it obtains one.
BlockedUnlockPickup.u2: Here, the agent must keep the key and make sure the door is open before moving on. Losing the key causes a return to the earlier phase, while an open door is the necessary condition to progress further.
BlockedUnlockPickup.u3: The agent now needs to reach the designated goal. If it is not yet at the goal, it continues its attempts to get there.
BlockedUnlockPickup.u4: Once in this final stage, the agent has already accomplished the objective, and no further progress is required.

DoorKey-v2.u0: At this stage, the agent needs to acquire a key. If the agent does not have the key yet, it remains here. Once the key is obtained, the agent can progress to the next objective.
DoorKey-v2.u1: Here, the agent already has the key and must unlock the door. If the key is lost, the agent reverts to the previous stage. Otherwise, if the door becomes unlocked, the agent can advance further. If the door stays locked, the agent remains in this stage.
DoorKey-v2.u2: In this stage, the agent must move to the goal location. Until the agent is at the goal, it remains in this stage. Upon reaching the goal, it transitions to the final stage.
DoorKey-v2.u3: Having reached the goal, the agent has completed all tasks and remains in this final stage indefinitely.

DoorKey.u0: At this point, the primary requirement is to have the key. If the agent does not possess the key, it remains in this phase until it obtains one.
DoorKey.u1: Here, the agent must keep the key and make sure the door is open before moving on. Losing the key causes a return to the earlier phase, while an open door is the necessary condition to progress further.
DoorKey.u2: The agent now needs to reach the designated goal. If it is not yet at the goal, it continues its attempts to get there.
DoorKey.u3: Once in this final stage, the agent has already accomplished the objective, and no further progress is required.

KeyCorridor.u0: In this starting stage, the agent must step onto the purple door without having the key in order to advance. If that doesn’t happen, it stays here.
KeyCorridor.u1: In this stage, the agent needs to acquire the key to move on. If it doesn’t pick up the key, it remains here.
KeyCorridor.u2: Here, the agent can progress by using the purple door while holding the key. If the agent loses the key, it returns to the stage focused on retrieving a key again.
KeyCorridor.u3: In this stage, the agent must open the red door to advance. If the agent loses the key, it must go back to the stage where it can be reacquired. Otherwise, it stays here.
KeyCorridor.u4: At this point, the agent should reach the final goal. If it does not achieve that, it continues attempting to do so in this stage.

UnlockToUnlock.u0: At this stage, the agent has not yet collected the yellow key. The only way to move forward is to pick up the yellow key. If that does not happen, the agent remains here.
UnlockToUnlock.u1: Here, the agent possesses the yellow key. The next objective is to open the yellow door in order to progress. If the yellow key is lost, the agent reverts to the earlier stage without the key. Otherwise, without opening the door, it stays in this stage.
UnlockToUnlock.u2: Now, the agent has passed the yellow door but has not acquired the red key. Picking up the red key is necessary to advance. Until the red key is obtained, the agent remains in this stage.
UnlockToUnlock.u3: In this stage, the agent holds the red key. Opening the red door is the immediate goal to move on. If the red key is lost, the agent returns to the stage where the red key still needs to be acquired. Otherwise, it remains here if no further progress is made.
UnlockToUnlock.u4: Having opened the red door, the agent can either enter the goal room or pick up the ball to reach the final phase. Without doing either, the agent stays at this stage.
UnlockToUnlock.u5: The agent has completed the necessary tasks and remains in the final stage.
